caption: The drawing is composed of black and gray pencil sketches on a beige background. It features detailed renderings of metal hardware objects, likely historical hinges and a latch. The upper left and lower left show two large, darkly shaded, heart-shaped strap hinges, each with large round rivets and a curved, tapering band connecting both heart shapes. To the right of the upper strap hinge is a technical side-view line drawing of the same hinge, revealing the profile of its curvature and attachment; above this, another front-view outline of the hinge is drawn with a simple line. A small horizontal scale marked in inches is present for size reference below these views. The lower right corner contains a shaded drawing of a latch with a spiral end, two attachment loops, and a hook, rendered in darker pencil. Above this, to the right, is an outline side view of the latch, showing its curled end and shape, accompanied by another small scale. Lines are clear and precise, and the objects are rendered with an emphasis on shape, function, and construction detail. The name "Mildred Ford" is handwritten in the bottom left corner outside the border, and there is an artist’s stamp at the bottom right.
title: Latch
